test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The cash difference between the selling prices of an article at a profit of 8% and at a loss of 4% is Rs. 54. Find the cost price of the article.
solution:
Given:

The cash difference between the selling prices of an article at a profit of 8% and at a loss of 4% is Rs. 54.

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

2. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the article be Q.

According to the concept,

Q(1 + 8%) - Q(1 - 4%) = 54

⇒ Q(1.08 - 0.96) = 54

⇒ Q = 54/0.12

⇒ Q = 450

∴ The cost price of the article Rs. 450.
